summary: Phaos Technology Holdings (Cayman) Limited filed a Form 6-K announcing the postponement of its extraordinary general meeting (EGM) originally scheduled for August 18, 2026, rescheduled to August 31, 2026. The board postponed to revise language of certain proposals, ensuring shareholders have adequate review time. Record date remains July 8, 2026. Original proxy materials are superseded; previously submitted votes will not count. This is a procedural scheduling update, not a substantive corporate transaction. Watch for the revised proxy filings to understand the substance of the proposals being revised, which may indicate an underlying special situation.
